evidence: We expect that there will continue to be new laws, regulations and industry standards concerning data privacy and data protection, including artificial intelligence, in the U.S., the EU and other jurisdictions
we cannot yet determine the impact such laws, regulations, interpretations and standards may have on our business

emerging and changing data privacy and data protection requirements as well as other new and upcoming European and U.S. federal and state privacy and cybersecurity laws and industry standards may cause us to incur substantial fines, additional significant costs or require us to change our business practices
ai_positioning.summary: UGI adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, exprimant des préoccupations sur les risques réglementaires et de conformité liés aux lois sur la protection des données et l'IA émergentes, sans mentionner d'initiatives propres d'IA.
